overview: Distance vector vs link state, RIP/OSPF/BGP, forwarding table lookup, bridge spanning tree, transfer-time through path.
coreConcept: DV neighbours se shortest distance seekhta hai (Bellman-Ford); LS poori topology flood karta hai (Dijkstra).
hinglishExplanation: RIP distance vector hai (hop count, max 15), OSPF link state. BGP path-vector, inter-AS. Forwarding me longest prefix match. Bridges spanning tree se loops rokte hain.
formalDefinition: DV neighbours se shortest distance seekhta hai (Bellman-Ford); LS poori topology flood karta hai (Dijkstra).
importantProperties: RIP: DV, hop count, UDP; OSPF: link-state, Dijkstra, IP directly.
Router TTL decrement karta hai, checksum recompute.
Store-and-forward path time = sum of per-link times.
commonPitfalls: RIP ko link state maan lena.
